subject: Clarification needed: SOC 2 Type II report - end-of-period timestamp edge case
messages:
From: Lydia Hayes <lydia@brightlane-audit.com>
To: nikhil_sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Acme Compliance <compliance@acme-corp.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jul 2025 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: SOC 2 period question — treating 2025-06-30 timestamps

Hi Nikhil,

Quick question as we prepare final test work for Acme's SOC 2 Type II: the report lists the period as 2025-01-01 through 2025-06-30. For evidence extraction we want to confirm the inclusive/exclusive interpretation of the end date. Specifically:

- For system event timestamps (UTC) are events with timestamp 2025-06-30T00:00:00 included? What about exactly 2025-06-30T23:59:59?
- Some of the backups/snapshots for the service are taken at 00:00 UTC on 2025-07-01 (i.e., a snapshot that contains data through 2025-06-30 at 23:59:59). Do you treat the snapshot as in-scope for the 06-30 end date?
- Are there any services where the audit evidence is based on object metadata (S3 last-modified) rather than event timestamps? That can cause off-by-one ambiguities.

I've attached our short ask list (SOC2_asklist_20250722.pdf) and can accept either raw system event exports or signed bridge language if needed — but I wanted to confirm Redwood's preferred/easiest approach here so we don't collect the wrong artifacts.

Would you be able to confirm by end of day tomorrow? We have some dependency on the test schedule.

Thanks,
Lydia Hayes
Senior Auditor, Brightlane Audit
lydia@brightlane-audit.com

Attachments: SOC2_asklist_20250722.pdf (10KB)
From: nikhil_sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Hayes <lydia@brightlane-audit.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Acme Compliance <compliance@acme-corp.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jul 2025 17:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SOC 2 period question — treating 2025-06-30 timestamps

Hi Lydia — thanks for the clear note and the ask list. Quick summary and proposed path forward so we align with your test plan:

1) Our intended interpretation: the SOC 2 Type II period of 2025-01-01 through 2025-06-30 is inclusive of events up to 2025-06-30 23:59:59 UTC.

2) Evidence types and caveats:
   - System event logs (CloudTrail, application event streams): these are event-time stamped in UTC. We will provide exports filtered by event timestamp <= 2025-06-30T23:59:59Z.
   - Backups / DB snapshots: full backups are scheduled at 00:00 UTC on 2025-07-01 and therefore contain records through 2025-06-30 23:59:59Z. We can provide a checksum and metadata for the 2025-07-01 00:00 snapshot and a separate smaller export that is explicitly cut at 2025-06-30T23:59:59Z if you prefer a point-in-time CSV.
   - S3 object last-modified: we agree this can be ambiguous. For S3-based logs we will provide both the event timestamp (inside the log entry) and the S3 last-modified timestamp so you can see the raw event time.

3) Proposed deliverables for your review:
   - CloudTrail export (events <= 2025-06-30T23:59:59Z) — filename: audit-export-20250630-235959.log (attached sample).
   - DB point-in-time export (CSV) truncated at 2025-06-30T23:59:59Z.
   - Draft bridge letter confirming inclusive interpretation for the audit period for artifacts where a system snapshot is used rather than per-event exports.

Question for you: will Brightlane accept the above (event-timestamp exports + snapshot metadata + bridge letter) as equivalent to raw system-level logs for the controls you plan to test? If you need additional system-level evidence (e.g., syslog with host timestamps), please flag those specific sources and we will prioritize them.

I can prepare the sample CloudTrail export and a bridge-letter draft by tomorrow EOD. If that works, I'll share in this thread and we can get sign-off.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai

Attachments: (sample will be shared in follow-up)
From: Lydia Hayes <lydia@brightlane-audit.com>
To: nikhil_sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Acme Compliance <compliance@acme-corp.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jul 2025 18:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SOC 2 period question — treating 2025-06-30 timestamps

Thanks for the quick and thorough response, Nikhil. That approach should be fine — two quick clarifications:

- For the CloudTrail export, please ensure the event_timestamp field is included as an ISO8601 UTC value; we will use that for test selection.
- The bridge letter should state that for the purpose of the 2025-01-01 to 2025-06-30 reporting period, Redwood treats the end date as inclusive through 2025-06-30T23:59:59Z, and it should call out any evidence sources where the object's last-modified timestamp may differ from the event timestamp (S3, snapshot metadata).

If you can post a sample export to the Drive link and a draft bridge letter by EOD tomorrow, we can confirm acceptance and lock the test schedule.

Appreciate it — Lydia
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: nikhil_sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jul 2025 19:05:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 period question — treating 2025-06-30 timestamps

Evelyn — forwarding Lydia's confirmation and Nikhil's proposed deliverables. Action items for infra/compliance team:

- Generate CloudTrail export filtered by event_timestamp <= 2025-06-30T23:59:59Z and include event_timestamp in ISO8601 UTC. Place sample at the Drive link and attach the full export to the secure upload. (Owner: infra runbook owner)
- Produce DB CSV truncated at 2025-06-30T23:59:59Z and a checksum for the 2025-07-01 00:00 snapshot. (Owner: DB team)
- Draft bridge letter (one page) with the inclusive language Lydia requested. I'll draft the first pass and attach bridge-letter-draft.docx here for review. (Owner: Marissa — please review and sign-off)
- Confirm whether any third-party logs (CDN, vendor monitoring) use local timestamps; if so we need mapping to UTC.

I'll coordinate and post artifacts to the secure Drive by tomorrow EOD. Nikhil — can you also confirm whether legal needs to sign the bridge letter before we send to Brightlane?

Thanks — Marissa
VP, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: bridge-letter-draft.docx (12KB)
